newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebec prison incident ends, three inmates arrested.
newsitem.headline: Quebec prison incident ends, three inmates arrested.

text.p: Three guards who had been held hostage for about seven hours at a provincial detention center in Valleyfield were released early Friday and three inmates have been arrested, Quebec Provincial Police spokesman Gerard Carrier said.

Carrier said the guards had been taken prisoner about 11 p.m. EST Thursday (0300 GMT) after some prisoners attempted to escape. One inmate reached the roof but gave himself up to police about 40 minutes later.
Two other inmates who locked three guards inside a cell on the third floor of the detention center had been arrested as suspects in the escape attempt and the hostage incident, he said.
Carrier said a member of the police intervention group entered the jail about 5:45 a.m. EST (1045 GMT) and negotiated the release of the three guards.
"We are searching inside the detention center to see if handmade arms were involved," he said. "Everything is under control, the operation is concluded and no one was hurt."
Carrier said a total 60 prisoners were inside the facility, where inmates with sentences of two years or less are housed. Valleyfield is about 18 miles (30 kms) south of Montreal.
